scenarios.title: Tenant isolation
scenarios.given: Tenant A owns a run
scenarios.when: Tenant B submits its run ID
scenarios.then: Return non-enumerating denial; no state or timing-sensitive detail is disclosed

scenarios.title: Publish is not source authority
scenarios.given: Publisher can edit workflow but cannot authorize expense decisions
scenarios.when: They add a direct approval action
scenarios.then: Catalog/compiler and source service reject it

scenarios.title: Revocation after preflight
scenarios.given: A valid publication preflight exists
scenarios.when: Publisher/source grant is revoked before confirmation
scenarios.then: Confirmation fails without publication or side effect

scenarios.title: Runtime revocation
scenarios.given: An operation is queued
scenarios.when: Source capability is revoked before dispatch
scenarios.then: Operation blocks with safe reason and no forbidden call

scenarios.title: Confidential existence
scenarios.given: A sealed care run exists
scenarios.when: An ordinary admin filters, searches, exports, or counts workflows
scenarios.then: No name, membership, count, or audit existence signal escapes

scenarios.title: Derived sensitive fact
scenarios.given: A care-only fact would determine an outward message
scenarios.when: A user attempts a condition over it
scenarios.then: Compilation blocks unauthorized use and derived information flow

scenarios.title: Cross-entity request
scenarios.given: A valid tenant contains two Legal Entities
scenarios.when: Workflow attempts incompatible source action across entity scopes
scenarios.then: Owning service rejects; no implicit entity/currency coercion

scenarios.title: Assignment is not permission
scenarios.given: An interviewer is assigned
scenarios.when: They request unrelated care or donor data
scenarios.then: Server projection denies unrelated data

scenarios.title: Unknown is not false
scenarios.given: A reference clearance fact is not yet known
scenarios.then: Run waits/blocks; it does not decline or take fallback

scenarios.title: Overlapping cases
scenarios.given: Two cases are true
scenarios.then: Ambiguity blocks; no first-row winner

scenarios.title: True plus unknown
scenarios.given: One exclusive case is true and another unknown
scenarios.then: Exclusivity is not proved; no action starts

scenarios.title: Required join category
scenarios.given: Two nonchurch references arrive; church reference is mandatory
scenarios.then: Requirement remains unsatisfied until required source category qualifies

scenarios.title: Unselected branch
scenarios.given: A guarded branch is known false
scenarios.when: Parallel join waits on selected work
scenarios.then: False branch is not awaited and does not count as evidence

scenarios.title: Empty parallel selection
scenarios.given: No branch activates and onEmpty is block
scenarios.then: It blocks rather than silently succeeding

scenarios.title: Unavailable branch output
scenarios.given: A downstream input depends on an optional branch without export handling
scenarios.then: Compiler rejects the dataflow reference

scenarios.title: No coercion
scenarios.given: String "false" or "100" appears where Boolean/integer is required
scenarios.then: Validation fails; no JavaScript truthiness

scenarios.title: Currency-safe threshold
scenarios.given: USD threshold meets a THB fact
scenarios.then: Incompatible money context cannot pass through numerical comparison

scenarios.title: Incomplete first-gift history
scenarios.given: An import omits earlier gifts
scenarios.then: Source fact remains unknown; no fabricated welcome eligibility

scenarios.title: Duplicate event
scenarios.given: An accepted event has already created an effect
scenarios.when: Same event arrives after provider dedupe expires
scenarios.then: Permanent source semantic identity prevents duplicate effect

scenarios.title: Out-of-order commit
scenarios.given: Higher-numbered outbox row commits first
scenarios.when: Consumer advances while lower row is uncommitted
scenarios.then: Lower accepted row is eventually processed; cursor protocol does not skip it

scenarios.title: Historical import
scenarios.given: Legacy gifts are imported
scenarios.then: Historical effects remain dark absent explicit reviewed backfill

scenarios.title: Wrong source
scenarios.given: A raw payment provider callback exists
scenarios.when: A user attempts to treat it as posted contribution
scenarios.then: No donation stewardship enrollment until owning source qualifies facts

scenarios.title: Cross-workflow loop
scenarios.given: Workflow A triggers B and B triggers A
scenarios.then: Chain is quarantined visibly without unbounded execution

scenarios.title: Wrong correlation
scenarios.given: An old signature for a superseded agreement arrives
scenarios.then: It cannot satisfy current agreement requirement

scenarios.title: Completion before wait
scenarios.given: Reference completion commits before wait row
scenarios.then: Immediate source recheck discovers accepted completion

scenarios.title: Completion after wait
scenarios.given: Wait row commits first
scenarios.then: Consumer locates exact wait and advances it

scenarios.title: Lost wake
scenarios.given: Source evidence and wait exist
scenarios.when: Immediate dispatch and event wake are lost
scenarios.then: Indexed reconciliation eventually advances from source facts

scenarios.title: Two simultaneous completions
scenarios.given: Two required branches finish
scenarios.when: Both workers try to advance join
scenarios.then: One accepted transition; both evidence records preserved

scenarios.title: Cancel while queued
scenarios.given: Reminder is prepared but not dispatched
scenarios.then: Epoch/fence check suppresses stale reminder

scenarios.title: Cancel after accepted send
scenarios.given: Provider accepted the message
scenarios.then: UI records irreversible send and cancels only remaining safe work

scenarios.title: Expired lease after dispatch
scenarios.given: Worker may have sent externally then disappears
scenarios.then: Operation becomes uncertain; no blind second send

scenarios.title: Concurrent draft editors
scenarios.given: Two users edit revision 4
scenarios.when: Second writes after first creates revision 5
scenarios.then: Conflict is visible; no silent overwrite

scenarios.title: New template publication
scenarios.given: Applicant runs on version 1
scenarios.then: Applicant remains on version 1

scenarios.title: Individual extra interview
scenarios.given: One applicant requires an added interview
scenarios.then: Only that run changes; completed evidence remains

scenarios.title: Cosmetic layout edit
scenarios.given: Template graph is rearranged
scenarios.then: Execution digest and business effects remain unchanged

scenarios.title: Retired contract
scenarios.given: A referenced form/action is retired
scenarios.then: Dependency check blocks or requires explicit compatible binding

scenarios.title: Runtime upgrade
scenarios.given: Old run uses action contract v1
scenarios.then: Old run executes supported v1 or is controlled-blocked for migration

scenarios.title: Postcompletion evidence correction
scenarios.given: Completed onboarding evidence is revoked by its owner
scenarios.then: Linked remediation is created; historical accepted decision is not rewritten

scenarios.title: Business-day timing
scenarios.given: Task due uses a holiday calendar
scenarios.then: Proposed due time follows pinned business calendar

scenarios.title: DST gap
scenarios.given: Local schedule targets a nonexistent clock time
scenarios.then: Next valid instant is used and resolution recorded

scenarios.title: Pause clocks
scenarios.given: Relative reminder and fixed document expiry coexist
scenarios.then: Relative remaining duration freezes; fixed expiry continues

scenarios.title: Outage catch-up
scenarios.given: Many routine reminders become overdue
scenarios.then: Policy coalesces safely; no catch-up message flood

scenarios.title: Lost provider response
scenarios.given: Provider accepts message but response is lost
scenarios.then: Reconcile or review; do not send a new blind copy

scenarios.title: Shared purpose
scenarios.given: Organization and missionary workflows request identical effect
scenarios.then: Owning semantic key converges to one effect or reports incompatible payload conflict

scenarios.title: Suppression changed
scenarios.given: Optional message was prepared
scenarios.then: Current source policy suppresses appropriate message; required security policy remains separate

scenarios.title: Webhook duplicate/order
scenarios.given: Delivery/bounce events repeat and arrive out of order
scenarios.then: Deduped source facts retain correct meaning, not last-arrival overwrite

scenarios.title: Reply threading
scenarios.given: Applicant replies to an approved workflow email
scenarios.then: Reply joins Support Hub/CRM context; no parallel workflow inbox

scenarios.title: Trace minimization
scenarios.given: Private record is needed inside action
scenarios.then: No raw values, signed URLs, bodies, or secrets appear in step state/logs

scenarios.title: Protected review
scenarios.given: Reviewer task receives a checkbox completion
scenarios.when: No source approval has been accepted
scenarios.then: Financial/appointment evidence does not become approved

scenarios.title: External scanner
scenarios.given: Email scanner follows a reference link
scenarios.then: No consume, sign, submit, grant, or irreversible action

scenarios.title: External scope
scenarios.given: Reference has a valid task session
scenarios.then: Non-enumerating denial; no membership granted

scenarios.title: Double submission
scenarios.given: Mobile connection drops after accepted submit
scenarios.then: Original accepted submission is returned; no duplicate evidence

scenarios.title: Quarantined file
scenarios.given: Uploaded evidence is quarantined
scenarios.then: File cannot qualify; safe replacement path exists

scenarios.title: Old revision approval
scenarios.given: Content was approved then edited
scenarios.then: Exact-revision check blocks unreviewed content

scenarios.title: Noisy neighbor
scenarios.given: One tenant admits a 10x optional batch
scenarios.when: Other tenants have essential due work
scenarios.then: Accepted work remains safe and agreed service targets are measured, not assumed

scenarios.title: Orchestration outage
scenarios.given: Source writes succeed while Inngest is unavailable
scenarios.then: Source receipts/outbox persist and independent outage alert fires

scenarios.title: Restore safety
scenarios.given: Database backup predates sent email and grant revocation
scenarios.then: Outbound remains disabled until effects/revocations/tombstones reconcile

scenarios.title: Missing provider
scenarios.given: A blueprint references uncertified signing
scenarios.then: No mock success; automatic lane stays unavailable and valid manual path is labeled

scenarios.title: A11y authoring
scenarios.given: Staff uses keyboard and screen reader
scenarios.when: They create, validate and publish a permitted simple rule
scenarios.then: Complete outline path and focus/error feedback are usable

scenarios.title: Poor network
scenarios.given: Participant loses connection
scenarios.then: Input is preserved safely; state remains pending until authoritative acceptance

scenarios.title: Subflow authority
scenarios.given: Parent has narrower permissions than reusable child
scenarios.then: Intersection applies; child cannot widen data or command authority

scenarios.title: Subflow cancellation
scenarios.given: Parent stops future work
scenarios.when: Child has queued and already-dispatched work
scenarios.then: Cancellation propagates safely with irreversible work reported

scenarios.title: Template import
scenarios.given: Inert portable blueprint contains foreign IDs or executable strings
scenarios.then: Validation rejects unsafe content; valid import remains disabled and requires rebinding

scenarios.title: Retention request
scenarios.given: A run contains source evidence references under hold
scenarios.then: No hold release/disposal; owner governs lifecycle
